newsitem.title: USA: Trans World Air stake cut by FMR group.
newsitem.headline: Trans World Air stake cut by FMR group.

text.p: A group led by FMR Corp on Monday said it cut its stake in Trans World Airlines Inc to 0.81 percent, or 337,412 common shares.

The group disclosed its latest position on Trans World Airlines in a 13G filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. FMR Corp is the parent to Fidelity Management & Research Co, investment adviser to Fidelity Funds.
Filings under 13G are usually made by institutions and large investors with passive investment objectives in a company. In contrast with 13D filings, 13G reports do not list the latest transactions.
